{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Remove QA rows
sales_filtered = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales_filtered[sales_filtered['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print all key numbers for audit
print("Number of QA rows identified (should be 6):", qa_count)
print("Mean revenue of completed orders after cleaning and filtering:", mean_revenue)"}
